text.en:
Barangays Tuka, Buadiposo-Lilod, Pualas, Lumbatan II, Tarik, Sapot, Gata, Villa-Tangkal,
Tamporong, Bangon I, Katogonan, Tagondingan, Buadiposo-Proper, Lumbac, Minanga, Cadayonan,
Kabasaran, Lumbatan III, Tangkal, Baital, Raya-Bubong, Bubong, Bacolod, Pendolongan, Lumbatan I,
Dansalan, Manacab, Buntong, Raya-Buntong, Bangon II, Kalakala, and Paling, all in the municipality of
Ditsa-Ramain, province of Lanao del Sur, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute
into a distinct and independent municipality of Buadiposo-Buntong without affecting in any manner the legal
existence of the mother municipality of Ditsaan-Ramain.
The seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Manacab.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities shall be applicable to the new municipality of Buadiposo-Buntong.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Ditsaan-Ramain shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Buadiposo-Buntong until the
municipal officials of said municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so
appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal
officials following the issuance of this decree and shall have qualified, unless removed at the pleasure of the
President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the
government personnel of the municipality of Buadiposo-Buntong shall be appointed as provided for under
existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new municipality of

Buadiposo-Buntong in the obligations, funds, assets and other property of the Municipality of Ditsaan-Ramain
shall be transferred by the President to the newly created municipality upon recommendation of the
Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of May in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-seven.
